title: Outer approximation inside an open set of finite mass
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ and let μ be a measure on ℝ^N = Euclidean N (Euclidean metric, Borel σ-algebra). Let W ⊆ ℝ^N be open with μ(W) < ∞. Let A ⊆ W be an arbitrary, not necessarily measurable, set and let ε ∈ [0, ∞] with μ(A) < ε, where μ(A) is the outer measure. Then there is an open set O with A ⊆ O ⊆ W and μ(O) < ε.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (W A : Set (Euclidean N)) (ε : ℝ≥0∞), IsOpen W → μ W ≠ ∞ → A ⊆ W → μ A < ε → ∃ O : Set (Euclidean N), IsOpen O ∧ A ⊆ O ∧ O ⊆ W ∧ μ O < ε
